description: Defines a GatewayHealthMonitor class responsible for performing periodic health checks. It manages asynchronous tasks, handles timeouts, and invokes a failure callback upon consecutive failures.

classes.name: GatewayHealthMonitor
classes.description: A class for monitoring the health status of a gateway by performing periodic checks.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the GatewayHealthMonitor with configuration parameters and a sleep function.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the health monitoring process with specified check and failure handling callbacks.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing health check task.

methods.name: runCheck
methods.description: Performs a single check with optional timeout, returning whether the check succeeded.
